messages:
pagerbot: :rotating_light: Pager duty – high error rate (5xx) and elevated latency observed for Hosted API and several Dedicated pools in eu-central-1. Assigned: elena-oncall.

elena-oncall: I can see spike in 502/504s starting ~10m ago. Service graphs show NAT egress errors and increased STS token latency.
sam-ops: Confirming, logs show upstream oauth provider returning 502/503 for token requests from eu-central-1. Also seeing 'connect reset by peer' from our nat instances.
elena-oncall: Running quick curl against STS endpoint from one of the affected nodes:
```
curl -v https://sts.eu-central-1.amazonaws.com -H 'X-Test: probe' \n# returns HTTP/1.1 503 Service Unavailable
```
matt-sre: Incident created INC-2026-345. Start mitigation: divert traffic at the edge for non-region-pinned customers to eu-west-1. Can someone prepare the routing override?
elena-oncall: I'm starting the routing override now for hosted-api global routes (10% canary -> 100% if stable). Leaving Dedicated pools untouched until we confirm no auth drift.
april-eng: Heads-up: some Dedicated tenants are region-pinned. For them we should enable model-variant fallbacks and increase retry/backoff to reduce retry storms.
lena-support: CS: we have a handful of customers reporting increased 5xx in eu-central-1, estimating ~12% of requests affected. Drafting banner for status.redwood.ai.
sam-ops: Temporary mitigation checklist:
- enable edge routing override to eu-west-1
- apply egress circuit-breaker for oauth provider (rate-limit token refresh)
- enable immediate retry with jitter for STS calls
- drop long-running non-critical background jobs from eu-central-1
```yaml
# quick egress circuit-breaker example
egress:
  oauth_provider:
    max_retries: 2
    backoff_ms: 300
    fail_open_after: 10
```
elena-oncall: Applied canary (10%) -> metrics look good at canary after 2m: error budget dropped ~80% for that slice. Increasing to 50% now.
matt-sre: Oncall handoff in 30m to matt-sre. I'll take ownership for the long tail and customer comms. Elena, thanks for the triage. :thumbsup: 
elena-oncall: Handoff acknowledged. Notes: root cause looks like regional NAT fleet degradation causing downstream oauth token failures and STS latency. We saw correlated CloudWatch logs showing high conntrack and ENI errors.
incident-bot: Logged mitigation actions against INC-2026-345: routing-override, circuit-breaker, reduced retries, customer banner.
lena-support: Status update ready: "We're investigating elevated errors in eu-central-1 affecting some Hosted API and Dedicated customers. We've routed traffic for non-region-pinned customers to eu-west-1 and are applying mitigations. More updates in 30 minutes." Should I post now?
matt-sre: Yes, post now. Also ask customers with region-pinned workloads if they'd like a manual failover. Capture affected customer IDs and escalate enterprise accounts.
april-eng: For pinned Dedicated pools we pushed a model-variant fallback to smaller quantized models to reduce memory/latency pressure when tokens fail. This reduces throughput by ~10% but cuts error amplification.
sam-ops: Long-term follow-up: replace NAT fleet, add additional ENI monitoring, improve conntrack autoscaling policy. Create GH issue linking CloudWatch spikes + kdump logs.
elena-oncall: Anything else? If canary reaches 100% and errors hold low, we'll close the pager.
matt-sre: I'll monitor, coordinate with infra to schedule NAT fleet replacement window. Leaving this thread open for updates.
